name: marmalade
description: Author, review, theme, and export Mermaid diagrams. Ships 10 skills, 12 expert subagents (UX, IA, accessibility, security, DevOps, Python, Postgres, DX, docs-sync), validation hooks, and a deterministic export/lint toolchain.

diagram_dir.title: Diagram source directory
diagram_dir.description: Repo-relative directory where .mmd sources live. Used by export, drift detection, and docs sync.

export_dir.title: Rendered output directory
export_dir.description: Repo-relative directory where rendered SVG/PNG/PDF artifacts are written.

default_theme.title: Default theme preset
default_theme.description: Bundled preset used when no theme is named: light, dark, high-contrast, print, or brand.

export_formats.title: Default export formats
export_formats.description: Formats produced by a plain export run. Repeatable: svg, png, pdf.

strict_validation.title: Block writes that fail validation
strict_validation.description: When on, the PostToolUse hook blocks Claude on a Mermaid syntax error instead of only warning.

secret_scan.title: Scan diagrams for secrets and internal hostnames
secret_scan.description: Runs a PreToolUse scan before a diagram is written, catching credentials, private IPs, and internal DNS names before they land in shared docs.
